doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Stage superstitions: hats on beds and whistling
summary: Hats on her bed mean the show will close and whistling in her dressing room is bad luck.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Most musicians have superstitions. Do you have any superstitions?
You can’t put your hat on my bed.
Can’t put your hat on your bed. Why?
That means the show’s gonna close.
And you can’t whistle in my dressing room.
